ocean_height_field — OPTICS watermedia op

• 資料種類:無 → table(僅由參數決定的運算子 —— 不接受影像或資料輸入)

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ocean_height_field(size, extent_m, wind_speed_mps, wind_dir_deg, t=0.0, seed=0, kind='pierson_moskowitz', directional='cos2', choppiness=0.0, depth_m=None, spreading_s=10.0, fetch_m=None, single_mode=None) -> 'dict'(要直接呼叫實作,import watermedia; watermedia.ocean_height_field(size, extent_m, wind_speed_mps, wind_dir_deg, t=0.0, seed=0, kind='pierson_moskowitz', directional='cos2', choppiness=0.0, depth_m=None, spreading_s=10.0, fetch_m=None, single_mode=None) -> 'dict';從台帳取用則 opsoptics.get("ocean_height_field"))

用法

時刻 t 的 Tessendorf(2001)FFT 海面 -> 字典(高度、斜率、法線圖、位移)。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

The wave-number spectrum is the omnidirectional spectrum of ocean_spectrum carried to the plane, psi(k, theta) = S(omega) D(theta) (d omega / d k) / k, with the dispersion omega^2 = g k (deep water) or omega^2 = g k tanh(k h) when depth_m is given. D is cos2 (2/pi cos^2 within 90 degrees of the wind) or cos2s (cos^(2s)((theta - theta_w) / 2), s = spreading_s), both normalised to 1 over the circle. The random amplitudes are h0(k) = (xi_r + j xi_i)/sqrt(2) sqrt(psi / 2) dk and h(k, t) = h0(k) e^(-j omega t) + conj(h0(-k)) e^(+j omega t), which is Hermitian, so the height is real (imag_residual reports the largest imaginary part left by the transform). The mean, the Nyquist row and column are zeroed. seed fixes the amplitudes:

the same seed gives the same sea at every t. choppiness moves each point horizontally by choppiness times the Tessendorf displacement (0 gives exactly zero displacement). size is the number of points per side (the grid is size x size over extent_m metres, wrap-around); wind_dir_deg is the direction the waves travel, from +x towards +y. single_mode=(mx, my, amplitude_m) replaces the random sea with one travelling cosine wave. The table has height, slope_x, slope_y (dh/dx, dh/dy), normal (H, W, 3), displacement_x / displacement_y, x_m / y_m, extent_m, variance_expected_m2 and slope_variance_expected (the sums of the spectrum over the modes in use), cox_munk_slope_variance (0.003 + 0.00512 U, Cox & Munk 1954), slope_variance_with_tail and omega_mode (single mode only). A sea of this kind has no capillary waves, so its resolved slope variance is far below the Cox & Munk value; slope_variance_with_tail adds the saturation range alpha / 2 ln(k_c / k_nyquist) of the spectrum up to the gravity-capillary wave number k_c = 370 rad/m. That agrees with Cox & Munk at 5 m/s and falls 40 % short at 10 m/s (the constant alpha of the Pierson-Moskowitz range does not grow with the wind); both are shown in the PoC.

該族通用的輸入契約(fail-closed)

optics 的每個運算子都先檢驗輸入再計算(不讓任何東西無聲通過):

• 單位寫進參數名 —— _mm / _um / _deg / _mrad。把 mm 和 µm 弄混不會當掉,而是給出「看似合理卻是錯的答案」,所以用命名來防。這裡絕不從數值大小去猜單位。

• 字串一律 ValueError —— float('50') 會成功,於是未解析的設定值會被當成長度混進來(實測:thin_lens('50', '200') 曾回傳看似合理的 66.667 mm)。bool 也按 True == 1 的隱式提升拒絕。

• complex / masked array 一律 ValueError(僅接受實數槽位;拒絕無聲丟棄虛部或剝掉遮罩)。所有輸入中的 NaN/Inf 一律 ValueError。

• 逐項點名拒絕除零及其近親:焦距 0、曲率半徑 0、折射率 <= 0、全不透明光闌(全為 0,正規化變成 0/0)、總和 <= 0 的 PSF、S0 = 0 的 Stokes 向量、物體位於前焦點(像在無窮遠)。

• 只有兩個運算子會回傳非有限值,而且都寫進了契約:depth_of_field 在超焦距以外回傳 far_mm = inf(這正是超焦距的定義),gaussian_beam 在束腰處回傳 wavefront_radius_mm = inf(平面波前的曲率半徑)。兩者都同時回傳一個有限的夥伴(far_is_infinite / curvature_per_mm)。除此之外的無聲 NaN/Inf 都在內部檢出並 ValueError ——「float64 溢位了」和「答案是無窮大」是兩種不同的主張,不能拿後者的臉去交付前者。

• 尺寸上限:生成網格受 optics.MAX_GRID(4096)限制,傳入的場/PSF/光闌受 optics.MAX_FIELD_ELEMENTS(2^24),ABCD 元件序列受 optics.MAX_SYSTEM_ELEMENTS(1024),Zernike 受 MAX_ZERNIKE_TERMS(512)/ MAX_ZERNIKE_ORDER(40)/ MAX_ZERNIKE_BASIS(2^25)。以 fail-closed 堵住「小參數引發巨大內部配置」的路徑(實測:n_max=40 × 4096² 需要 108 GB)。

• 物理上不可能的狀態同樣拒絕:偏振度 > 1 的 Stokes 向量、負穿透率、負強度、n-|m| 為奇數等非法 Zernike 指標。
